svg.title: We record why the allowances and maximum responses in the energy argument are uniform in the torus and are chosen before L. Suppose a cover kernel between types α, β satisfies P z eη|z|∥Kαβ(z)∥≤C, with η ≥0. Each physical summand is a scalar kernel coefficient times adjoint transport along its prescribed route, subject to the endpoint congruence and route cutoff. Adjoint transport is an isometry, including on winding routes; its operator norm is at most one. Thus the summand is bounded by the absolute cover coefficient with its endpoint indicator.
